notes: Complete list: 41 actions (actions.js, one object returned by GetActions, keys come from the ActionId table at the top of the file) and 5 advanced feedbacks (index.js init_feedbacks, registered with feedbacks[<id>] = {...}). Nothing is generated per model or conditionally registered. Variables and presets are not catalogued.

Protocol: the main actions send JSON over the ProPresenter remote-control WebSocket (ws://<host>:<port>/remote, default port 20652, index.js:941); the stage display connection is ws://<host>:<sdport>/stagedisplay (index.js:1017); an optional follower ProPresenter uses the same /remote protocol (index.js:1086). The nw* actions ("Network Link") use HTTP requests built from the same host/port (actions.js:52-60) and are described in the source as beta functionality.

Built on @companion-module/base ~1.4.3: options do not support expressions. Option regex values written as Regex.NUMBER / Regex.SIGNED_NUMBER are recorded with the values these constants have in @companion-module/base 1.15.0 and 2.2.1 (/^\d+$/ and /^[+-]?\d+$/); the 1.4.x dist itself was not inspected.

Pro7 dropdowns (Stage Display Screen, Stage Display Layout, Look, Macro) take their choices from internal state (id = UUID string, label = name) and start as the placeholder entry { id: "0", label: "Connect to Pro7 to Update" }. The lists are refreshed and the action/feedback definitions are re-registered whenever ProPresenter reports stage layouts, stage screens, looks or macros (index.js:1957-2017). They are therefore recorded with choicesNote and valueType string, not as closed lists. The source defaults of the three feedback dropdowns are the first list item (this.currentState.internal.<list>?.[0]?.id) and are not recorded.

Source oddities kept as written: enableFollowerControl has default "false" but its choices are "no" and "yes"; Pro7 action dropdowns have default "" (empty string). Tooltips of the source are recorded as option description.

Specific Slide (slideNumber) treats a leading + or - in "Slide Number" as a relative jump (actions.js:157-161); presentation paths use the format "<playlist index>:<item index>" or a bare item index (regex /^$|^\d+$|^\d+(\.\d+)*:\d+$/).

Possible defect seen when reading, not run: the nw* actions and newRandomNumber use this.config and this.updateVariable inside module-level arrow functions of actions.js (for example actions.js:56, 59 and 1255), where this is the exports object of that file and not the module instance. Whether this works at runtime was not checked.

Custom Action (customAction) sends any JSON message to ProPresenter; Custom Action (Network Link) (nwCustom) sends an arbitrary endpoint path with a JSON body. The source warns that wrong messages can crash ProPresenter.
